grammar.purpose: Give advice without turning it into a command
grammar.explanation: 该 and 应该 introduce what one should do: 我该带什么 / 应该先问. They do not guarantee an action has happened. 不该/不应该 negate the advised action. A question 我该… asks for guidance; 该不该… asks whether an action is advisable. Advice about a host’s needs still requires information from that host.

examples.zh: 我该带什么？你应该先问主人。
examples.py: wǒ gāi dài shén me ? nǐ yīng gāi xiān wèn zhǔ ren .
examples.en: What should I bring? You should ask the host first.

examples.zh: 我该不该带食物？主人说不用带。
examples.py: wǒ gāi bù gāi dài shí wù ? zhǔ ren shuō bù yòng dài .
examples.en: Should I bring food? The host said there was no need.

examples.zh: 不应该随便猜，先问清楚。
examples.py: bù yīng gāi suí biàn cāi , xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
examples.en: We should not guess casually; ask clearly first.

commonMistakes.why: To give advice use 应该 + action; adding 了 would change the reading to an inference or completed event.

grammar.pattern: 好吗 / 可以吗 / 行吗 / 怎么样
grammar.purpose: Make a proposal and check permission
grammar.explanation: 好吗 checks whether a proposal is acceptable: 六点半，好吗. 可以吗 and 行吗 commonly ask permission or feasibility: 我带水，可以吗. 怎么样 asks for an evaluation of a proposed option: 带书怎么样. These are not guarantees of agreement; the reply may accept, refuse or suggest another option. Use a real option before the question ending.

examples.py: liù diǎn bàn lái , hǎo ma ? hǎo .
examples.en: Come at half past six, okay? Okay.

examples.zh: 我带两瓶水，可以吗？行吗？可以。
examples.py: wǒ dài liǎng píng shuǐ , kě yǐ ma ? xíng ma ? kě yǐ .
examples.en: May I bring two bottles of water? Is that okay? Yes.

examples.zh: 带这本书怎么样？合适，她喜欢读书。
examples.py: dài zhè běn shū zěn me yàng ? hé shì , tā xǐ huān dú shū .
examples.en: How about bringing this book? Suitable; she likes reading.

commonMistakes.why: 好吗 evaluates an actual proposal; 带什么 asks for the missing choice.

dialogue.title: Ask the host first
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what is agreed, what is optional and when to arrive.

lines.zh: 晚餐去朋友家，我该带什么礼物？
lines.py: wǎn cān qù péng you jiā , wǒ gāi dài shén me lǐ wù ?
lines.en: For dinner at a friend’s home, what gift should I bring?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你应该先问主人。她没有要求客人带食物。
lines.py: nǐ yīng gāi xiān wèn zhǔ ren . tā méi yǒu yāo qiú kè ren dài shí wù .
lines.en: You should ask the host first. She has not required guests to bring food.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 带这本书怎么样？她喜欢读书。
lines.py: dài zhè běn shū zěn me yàng ? tā xǐ huān dú shū .
lines.en: How about this book? She likes reading.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 很合适。西餐中餐都不用带，主人今天做饺子。
lines.py: hěn hé shì . xī cān zhōng cān dōu bù yòng dài , zhǔ ren jīn tiān zuò jiǎo zi .
lines.en: Very suitable. No need to bring Western or Chinese food; the host is making dumplings today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我还可以带两瓶水，行吗？
lines.py: wǒ hái kě yǐ dài liǎng píng shuǐ , xíng ma ?
lines.en: Could I also bring two bottles of water?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以。她请求大家带来空瓶子，饭后带水回去。
lines.py: kě yǐ . tā qǐng qiú dà jiā dài lai kōng píng zi , fàn hòu dài shuǐ huí qù .
lines.en: Yes. She asks everyone to bring an empty bottle to take water home after the meal.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 桌上有筷子和碗吗？我可以帮忙。
lines.py: zhuō shàng yǒu kuài zi hé wǎn ma ? wǒ kě yǐ bāng máng .
lines.en: Are there chopsticks and bowls on the table? I can help.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有。你可以给三位客人拿三个碗。
lines.py: yǒu . nǐ kě yǐ gěi sān wèi kè ren ná sān gè wǎn .
lines.en: Yes. You can get three bowls for the three guests.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我早餐吃鸡蛋，午餐吃面包。有些食物不能吃。
lines.py: wǒ zǎo cān chī jī dàn , wǔ cān chī miàn bāo . yǒu xiē shí wù bù néng chī .
lines.en: I had eggs for breakfast and bread for lunch. There are some foods I cannot eat.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那应该提前告诉主人，别随便猜菜单。
lines.py: nà yīng gāi tí qián gào sù zhǔ ren , bié suí biàn cāi cài dān .
lines.en: Then tell the host in advance; do not casually guess the menu.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 晚餐六点半，六点半来，好吗？
lines.py: wǎn cān liù diǎn bàn , liù diǎn bàn lái , hǎo ma ?
lines.en: Dinner at half past six; come then, okay?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。我先告诉她，再带书和空瓶子。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ xiān gào sù tā , zài dài shū hé kōng píng zi .
lines.en: Okay. I will tell her first, then bring the book and an empty bottle.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我去朋友家吃晚餐，先问该带什么。
lines.py: wǒ qù péng you jiā chī wǎn cān , xiān wèn gāi dài shén me .
lines.en: I am going to a friend’s home for dinner; I first ask what I should bring.

lines.zh: 主人没有要求客人带食物，她做中餐，今天是饺子。
lines.py: zhǔ ren méi yǒu yāo qiú kè ren dài shí wù , tā zuò zhōng cān , jīn tiān shì jiǎo zi .
lines.en: The host has not required guests to bring food. She is making Chinese food: dumplings today.

lines.zh: 我想带书做礼物。朋友喜欢读书，带书很合适。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng dài shū zuò lǐ wù . péng you xǐ huān dú shū , dài shū hěn hé shì .
lines.en: I would like to bring a book as a gift. My friend likes reading, so it is suitable.

lines.zh: 我问带两瓶水可以吗，她说可以，还请求大家带来空瓶子。
lines.py: wǒ wèn dài liǎng píng shuǐ kě yǐ ma , tā shuō kě yǐ , hái qǐng qiú dà jiā dài lai kōng píng zi .
lines.en: I ask if I may bring two bottles of water. She says yes and also asks everyone to bring an empty bottle.

lines.zh: 瓶子饭后可以装水，筷子和碗她家都有。
lines.py: píng zi fàn hòu kě yǐ zhuāng shuǐ , kuài zi hé wǎn tā jiā dōu yǒu .
lines.en: The bottles can hold water after the meal; there are already chopsticks and bowls at her home.

lines.zh: 早餐我吃鸡蛋，午餐吃面包。西餐中餐都吃，但有些食物不能吃。
lines.py: zǎo cān wǒ chī jī dàn , wǔ cān chī miàn bāo . xī cān zhōng cān dōu chī , dàn yǒu xiē shí wù bù néng chī .
lines.en: I had eggs for breakfast and bread for lunch. I eat both Western and Chinese food, but cannot eat some foods.

lines.zh: 我应该提前告诉主人，不能随便猜她的菜单。
lines.py: wǒ yīng gāi tí qián gào sù zhǔ ren , bù néng suí biàn cāi tā de cài dān .

lines.zh: 六点半来，好吗？她这样问。我说好，带书、空瓶子，也先告诉她食物的事。
lines.py: liù diǎn bàn lái , hǎo ma ? tā zhè yàng wèn . wǒ shuō hǎo , dài shū , kōng píng zi , yě xiān gào sù tā shí wù de shì .
lines.en: “Come at half past six, okay?” she asks. I agree, bring the book and empty bottle, and tell her about food first.
